description: This file defines the main tab navigation widget for a Flutter application. It manages a bottom navigation bar allowing users to switch between Tasks, Projects, Tags, Dashboard, and Settings views. It includes a floating action button (FAB) for adding new tasks and displays different content based on the selected tab, utilizing internal classes for tab info and a 'coming soon' placeholder.

classes.name: MainTabs
classes.description: Main widget providing bottom tab navigation for the app.

classes.name: _MainTabsState
classes.description: State class managing the current tab index and UI rendering.

classes.name: _TabInfo
classes.description: Data class representing information about each tab.

classes.name: _ComingSoon
classes.description: Placeholder widget indicating features that are coming soon.

classes.name: TasksFabTapNotification
classes.description: Notification class used for delegating FAB actions to TasksPage.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the Scaffold with AppBar, bottom navigation, body content, and FAB based on current tab.

methods.name: _tabs
methods.description: Returns a list of tab info objects for rendering the bottom navigation and content.
